=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py: Entire file (451 lines, ends at main()) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The on-disk file lacks the trusted-source loader, its supporting functions and imports, and the `--trusted-source-repo`, `--trusted-source-branch`, and `--trusted-root` arguments.
  WHY: Trusted overlays are not loaded from a pinned default-branch commit, so a same-repository PR head can still change `.github/ai/WORKFLOW.md` and replace judge prompts at review time.
- scripts/render_prompt.py: lines 1284-1315, apply_workflow_overlay | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The on-disk file lacks `OVERLAY_REPLACE_DENIED_MODE_PATTERN`, `_overlay_replace_denied`, and the `replace_path` rejection guard.
  WHY: Judge-mode `replace_path` overrides are applied without warning, allowing a trusted `WORKFLOW.md` to replace the judge prompt.
- scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh: lines 162-167 (review path) and lines 819-828 (run_overlay_loader for validate path) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Both staging paths use the old checkout-based overlay loading without `--trusted-source-repo` or `--trusted-root`.
  WHY: The overlay is loaded from the untrusted PR/integration checkout instead of the default branch.
- tests/test_workflow_overlay_core.py: Entire file (365 lines) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The on-disk file lacks the trusted-source tests and fixtures, and `_run_render_prompt_py` lacks the `assemble_only` parameter.
  WHY: There is no test coverage for the claimed trusted-source security changes.
- tests/test_validate_workflow_validate_bootstrap.py: test_stage_workflow_support_helper_runs_overlay_loader_for_validate | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The on-disk test asserts the old overlay-loading snippets and lacks the new trusted-source assertions.
  WHY: The test can pass against the old code and provide false confidence that trusted-source staging is correct.
- scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py: lines 483-497, 525-527 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `fetch_trusted_overlay_source` fetches with `--filter=blob:none` but does not configure the bare repository's remote as a promisor remote before `materialize_trusted_file` reads blobs with `git show`.
  WHY: When a remote honors blob filtering, the overlay and fragment blobs are omitted and cannot be fetched on demand, so the loader disables valid trusted-source overlays; local `file://` fixtures mask the failure.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: lines 2603-2616 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The review/autofix staging step does not provide `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_TOKEN` for the trusted default-branch fetch, and the failure has no operator-facing signal beyond a warning in the run log.
  WHY: For private consumer repositories the fetch is unauthenticated and the configured overlay is silently disabled, while review/autofix and validate have different implicit-execution profiles.
- tests/test_workflow_overlay_core.py: `test_target_workflows_stage_schema_and_invoke_loader` review_autofix.yml branch, lines 590-592 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The review_autofix.yml assertions check `CURRENT_REPOSITORY="${{ github.repository }}"` but do not assert that the staging step provides `GH_TOKEN`.
  WHY: The missing credential regression is not contract-pinned for review/autofix.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]

  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: The on-disk apply_workflow_overlay at line 1303 applies replace_path unconditionally; no OVERLAY_REPLACE_DENIED_MODE_PATTERN regex exists; a grep for OVERLAY_REPLACE_DENIED returns zero matches.
- requirement: "The fetched overlay and fragments are usable by the loader on a real remote, not just on a local `file://` fixture." (PR intent: load the overlay from a pinned default-branch commit; the existing `test_trusted_overlay_blob_read_failure_disables_overlay` only tests the fail-open branch, not the success branch on a partial-clone remote)
  expected_change_site: `scripts/load_workflow_overlay.py::fetch_trusted_overlay_source` after `git remote add` (between lines 487 and 490 of the PR diff)
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The bare-repo setup at lines 483-497 never runs `git config remote.origin.promisor true` (or any equivalent such as `git config remote.origin.partialclonefilter blob:none` plus a configured promisor remote); no test exercises `git show <sha>:<path>` on a real partial-clone with omitted blobs; the existing `file://` fixture supplies every blob in the local object store.
